steps.title: Click a Card
steps.desc: Tap any card to flip it over and see the emoji hiding underneath!

steps.title: Find the Match
steps.desc: Flip a second card. If both emojis are the same, you found a pair!

steps.title: Win the Game
steps.desc: Match all 6 pairs in as few moves as possible to become a Memory Champion!

items.text: Foxes have amazing memories! They remember where they buried their food even months later.
Dolphins can remember other dolphins they met over 20 years ago. That is a super long time!
Playing memory games every day helps your brain grow stronger, just like exercise grows your muscles!
Astronauts train their memory to remember hundreds of buttons and switches on their spacecraft!
